content.cn:
夜裡追趕夜路的呼喊
是搖晃奔馳的卡車
轟隆隆隆隆
隆隆隆隆隆
就好像會有星星悄悄的
在漆黑的天花板閃爍
我睜著眼等待
一種勻稱緩慢的呼吸
帶來結束時刻的靜寂

content.en:
Chasing the night road with cries in the dark
A shaking, speeding truck
Rumbling, rumbling
Rumbling, rumbling
As if stars would quietly
Flicker on the pitch-black ceiling
I keep my eyes open, waiting
For an even, slow breath
To bring the silence of ending
